description: A civil complaint filed in a United States district court

court.description: The court named in the caption, as printed on its first line, e.g. 'IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT'

court_district.description: The district named on the caption's second line, as printed, e.g. 'NORTHERN DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA'

case_number.description: The case number, as printed in the court's filing stamp at the top of the page if the caption's case number box is blank, e.g. '3:25-cv-00951'

document_number.description: The docket document number from the filing stamp, e.g. '1'

filed_date.description: The filing date from the court's filing stamp at the top of the page, exactly as printed, e.g. '01/30/25'

document_title.description: The title of the pleading as printed in the caption, e.g. 'Complaint'

plaintiff.description: The plaintiff named in the caption, as printed

defendants.description: Each defendant named in the caption, as printed

plaintiff_counsel_office.description: The government office or law firm representing the plaintiff, as printed in the counsel block, e.g. 'United States Department of Justice, Antitrust Division'

nature_of_action.description: One sentence summarizing what the plaintiff seeks to prevent or recover, from the opening paragraph

challenged_transaction.description: The transaction the complaint challenges, if any

value.description: The stated value of the transaction, as printed, e.g. '$14 billion'

relevant_product_market.description: The relevant product market the complaint alleges, as named in the market definition section

relevant_geographic_market.description: The relevant geographic market the complaint alleges

claims.description: Each distinct statutory provision the complaint alleges the defendants violated or would violate, listed once even if cited repeatedly

statute.description: The provision, as named, e.g. 'Section 7 of the Clayton Act'

jurisdiction_basis.description: The statute under which the action is brought and the court has subject matter jurisdiction, with citation

venue_basis.description: The statutes cited for venue, with citations

relief_requested.description: Each lettered item in the request for relief, in order

numbered_paragraphs.description: The number of the last numbered paragraph in the complaint

date_signed.description: The date on the signature page, exactly as printed
